get.summary: How accounts can be created here, so the sign-in page can ask for an invite code.

post.summary: Invite someone without an account: they register with this code and the same email.

delete.summary: Owners can remove anyone; any member can leave.

put.summary:
Replace the whole map: features with a known ``id`` are updated, those without are
created, and existing features missing from the payload are deleted.

parameters.name: open
parameters.description: true: only todo/doing; false: only done

parameters.name: due_by
parameters.description: Due on or before this date (includes overdue)

post.summary: Mark done. A recurring task spawns its next occurrence.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Day to plan for; defaults to today (server date)

get.summary: Everything open that is due on or before ``date`` (so overdue jobs are included).

post.summary: Upload a photo or video. Time, GPS, size and thumbnail are read in the background.
Queue processing again, e.g. after a failure or if the broker was down at upload.

get.summary: The file or its thumbnail. Authorised by the signed ``t`` token from the media JSON.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Length of the daily history window, ending today (UTC)

parameters.name: today
parameters.description: Treat this as today (UTC); mainly for tests

get.summary: Per-day activity counts, weekly comparison, streaks and the newest photos.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search name, variety, supplier, latin name, notes

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Only packets with the activity in this month (1 to 12)

parameters.name: activity
parameters.description: With month: sow (indoors or outdoors) or one activity

delete.summary: Remove the packet. Its photos stay in the photo timeline, no longer linked to it.

post.summary: Start reading a photo already uploaded to the allotment. The result is a draft packet.
Run a failed (or stuck queued) scan again.

parameters.name: packet_id
parameters.description: Only trays with this packet sown in them

delete.summary: Remove the tray and its cells. Its photos stay in the photo timeline, unlinked.

patch.summary: Sow, germinate, fail or clear the chosen cells in one go. All or nothing.

put.summary: Connect or update the account. The token is checked against the instance first.

delete.summary: Disconnect. Queued posts are dropped; the history stays.

post.summary: Queue a test status. It is sent as 'direct' (only the account itself sees it).
Try a failed post again (or one stuck in 'sending' for over 15 minutes).

get.summary: Limits the browser should respect, so it can explain a problem before sending a file.

patch.summary: Rename a suggestion or change what kind of thing it is before accepting it.

post.summary: Turn suggestions into map features. All or nothing: if one is invalid none are added.
Throw suggestions away (accepted ones are left alone: they are already on the map).

get.summary: The checklist, with each distance's current length on the map.

post.summary: Add an extra distance between any two corners of a shape (a spare, to check a fit).
Make the checklist match the drawn shapes. Safe to repeat: nothing measured is lost.
post.description:
New shapes get their distances; distances for corners that no longer exist are removed
if unmeasured and kept (flagged stale) if they were measured.

patch.summary: Record a measurement, add a note, or skip it.

delete.summary: Remove an extra distance you added. The generated ones can only be skipped.

parameters.name: preview
parameters.description: true: only show the result; false: change the map

post.summary: Correct the drawn shapes to match the measurements.
post.description:
``preview=true`` (the default) only reports what would change. ``preview=false`` applies
it, all or nothing: if any corrected shape is invalid nothing is changed.

post.summary: Queue a build from photos and videos: recognised objects, the photo overlay, or both.
post.description:
Needs about 5+ overlapping images (a video counts as the frames sampled from it, about
one a second) and 3+ photos with a location, which place and scale the map.

delete.summary: Remove a finished job's record. Its layer, if any, stays until deleted itself.

post.summary: Stop a job: at once if it is still queued, within about ten seconds if running.

get.summary: One map tile. Authorised by the signed ``t`` token from the layer JSON.

total.description: Distances to take, not counting skipped ones
